title: DAO origin validator has a parsed-object mutation TOCTOU after raw provenance check
description: DaoOriginValidator.validate first validates immutable received-wire provenance, then continues reading dao.options from the caller-visible mutable DAO object. A concurrent mutation after the provenance check can substitute a different signature option while the transcript/digest still use the original raw bytes, potentially accepting an on-wire DAO whose original signature is invalid. Reparse the bound raw bytes into a detached local DAO and consume only detached semantics; add a deterministic mutation-race regression.
